versions.changelog:
Initial release — Modern Award Payroll Auditor for Australia.

- Audits payroll for compliance with all 121 Modern Awards under the Fair Work Act 2009.
- Identifies the correct award and employee classification based on industry and duties.
- Verifies base pay rates, penalty rates, overtime, allowances, annualised salary BOOT testing, casual loading, and superannuation.
- Includes detailed intake and decision tree processes to ensure accurate, award-compliant auditing.
- Provides clear criteria for when to use (and not use) the skill.
- Aligned with Fair Work Commission rules and 2025–26 minimum rates.
